mentions.name: Kith
mentions.description: Kith is a programming language being created by the author; it was originally going to be named Glyph, but the name was changed to Kith after discovering an existing language called GlyphLang.
mentions.source_excerpt: Funny I was going to make a programming language called Glyph as well but than i discovered GlyphLang so I decided to call it Kith instead.
